interpretation_guardrails: T0 snapshot and lifetime peak through selection are separate quantities; six people have a higher prior lifetime peak than the contemporaneous 2011 roster title implies.
Negative prior-career findings are evidence-audited but not metaphysical proof that no obscure higher role existed; confidence remains encoded in row-level audit metadata.
Repeat-selected 38 people were checked against the already frozen 2010 lifetime baseline, preventing earlier achievements from being lost.
Post-2011 advancement must compare outcomes only after 2011-04-01 against this frozen lifetime baseline.
freeze_policy: Do not silently alter v1.0. Any new pre-2011 evidence or rubric change requires v1.1 or later with an explicit changelog.
